svg.text: A Chromlens session in a browser tab
Read in place from 4DN, nothing uploaded
Only the view is read: 47 MB of a 7-GB map
Over 30 analyses, in a background worker
Each step logged as its command line
1D, 2D and 3D data on one coordinate system
FASTA, 2bit, BAM, VCF, bigWig, bedGraph, wig, BED, bigBed, GTF/GFF,
genePred, bedMethyl, barChart, splice junctions, cytoBand
One session, from a 2.6-Gb genome to single bases
measure: every output is the next input, across dimensions
a track like any other, for the next task
Every result is a track, a feature set, a map or a model of the session, so the next task can read it; each step is logged as its chromlens-run command and replays on other maps
